summary: Iteration 15 - Resend Email Integration Testing Complete. All 18 backend tests passed. Resend email integration is LIVE and working. Emails to howardjennings77@gmail.com (Resend account owner) are successfully delivered with real email_ids. Domain churvox.com is NOT verified, so provider auto-falls back to onboarding@resend.dev sender. Emails to other addresses fail in testing mode (expected behavior). invite_emails collection correctly stores email_id, provider, status, and error for each email attempt.
passed_tests: POST /api/email/test sends real email via Resend - returns success:true, provider:resend, email_id
POST /api/team/workers creates worker with status:'invited' and sends real invite email via Resend
POST /api/team/resend-invite/{id} sends real reminder email via Resend
POST /api/team/resend-invite/{id} fails for already active workers (400)
GET /api/invite/verify/{token} returns valid invite details (email, business_name)
POST /api/invite/accept activates worker account and sets password
Worker can login after accepting invite
Invited worker cannot login before accepting invite (401/403)
email_provider.py exists with ResendProvider, MockEmailProvider, and email templates
Email templates (invite, resend_invite, password_reset) generate valid HTML
invite_emails collection stores email records with email_id, provider, status, error
Backend starts without errors with RESEND_API_KEY configured
Email provider initialized as ResendProvider (verified via /api/email/test)
critical_code_review_comments: Resend integration is properly abstracted in email_provider.py - easy to swap providers
Domain fallback logic works correctly: tries churvox.com first, falls back to onboarding@resend.dev
invite_emails collection correctly tracks all email attempts with status, provider, email_id, error
Email failures don't block worker creation - invite link is still valid even if email fails
Environment variables properly used for Resend credentials (RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM)
HTML email templates are branded and well-structured
seed_data_creation: Test workers created and cleaned up during testing (prefixed with test_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 verified Resend email integration is LIVE. Key points: (1) RESEND_API_KEY is configured in backend/.env, (2) churvox.com domain is NOT verified in Resend, so emails are sent from onboarding@resend.dev, (3) Resend is in testing mode - only delivers to howardjennings77@gmail.com (account owner), (4) invite_emails collection stores all email attempts with status/provider/email_id/error, (5) Email failures don't block worker creation - invite link still works. SMS endpoints verified working (no regression from iteration 14).

live_integrations.resend_email: LIVE - POST /api/email/test, POST /api/team/workers, POST /api/team/resend-invite use real Resend API
live_integrations.clicksend_sms: LIVE - POST /api/sms/send and /api/sms/test use real ClickSend API
